artworks.title: A Corner of the Library in Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite, with white gouache on thick wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a portion of a grand, classical-style white building with ornate columns and decorative elements such as carved reliefs and intricate railings. The painting focuses on the upper section of the building, which features an elaborately adorned window or balcony in front of a large brown door. The portion of the building takes up the left side of the painting, while the right side shows a sky painted in soft blue, with sections of the blank off-white paper suggesting clouds.

artworks.title: East Indian Lotus (Nelumbo nucifera)
artworks.description: This painting shows two large white lotus flowers, one fully bloomed and the other in budding stage, with textured green leaves. The fully bloomed lotus is positioned towards the top-center, a large green leaf underneath it, while the closed bud is lower and slightly to the right, next to a thinner leaf. Green stems originate from the bottom of the painting and connect to the flowers and leaves. The background is beige.

artworks.title: Two Plums
artworks.medium: line and stipple engraving partially printed in color and finished by hand
artworks.description: The image shows two large fruits hanging from separate branches. The top fruit is round, orange with green leaves, while the bottom fruit is round and purple with green leaves. The color palette includes mainly earthy tones, with bright orange, rich purple, and green hues set against a pale, speckled background. The orange fruit is at the upper center, and the purple fruit is positioned below it towards the lower center, both hanging from branches extending slightly toward the composition's center.

artworks.title: Three Peaches
artworks.medium: line and stipple engraving partially printed in color and finished by hand
artworks.description: In the image, there are three large peaches arranged with one at the top, two below, and a sprig of peach blossoms in the center. The peaches are painted in shades of red, green, and yellow, with the top two showing greenish areas while the bottom left one has a light yellow tint. The blossoms are pink with green and brown accents for the leaves and branches. All objects are placed against a beige background with speckling.

artworks.title: Urocissa cucullata
artworks.description: This is a painting of several birds perched on branches amidst foliage and flowers. The painting depicts a main bird with striking black, white, and grey plumage standing atop a branch with its long, striped tail feathers cascading down. The bird has a vibrant yellow beak and is surrounded by lush, green leaves and delicate, light-colored flowers. Below, another bird of similar markings appears perched on a lower branch. Additional flora, including more leaves and flowers, enhance the naturalistic setting. This is in the style of John James Audubon, reflecting his detailed and lifelike portrayal of avian subjects.

artworks.title: Urocissa magnirostris
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird perched on a branch with two other birds in flight. The painting showcases a bird with black and white plumage, highlighted by a bold black head and chest, a vibrant yellow beak, and a long tail featuring black and white stripes. The bird is perched on a slender, brown branch adorned with glossy green leaves and pinkish flower buds. Accompanying it are two additional birds in mid-flight, exhibiting similar color patterns with dynamic wing positions. The details and soft pastel background create a harmonious scene. This is in style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Trogan personatus
artworks.description: This painting features three birds perched on a branch. The birds are identified as "Trogon Personatus" and are depicted with careful attention to detail. The upper bird has a brown back, while the two birds below it have green and pink plumage. The background consists of soft greens and creams. The leaves and branch are detailed, adding a naturalistic touch to the composition, reminiscent of the style of John Gould.

artworks.title: Flamingos and Shells
artworks.artist: Joh. Baptist Pfitzer after Acavie Baron
artworks.description: Two-section bird's-eye view illustration. Top section: hazy horizon, light blue sky merges with sea, rocky formation with shells. Mollusk extending towards the right. Additional shells scattered. Delicate, precise brushstrokes. Lower section: large pink flamingo with orange accent feathers on green land. Ocean with mountain range in the distance. Soft, swirling clouds in the sky. Other flamingos by shore near a small boat. Soft color palette with earthy tones and gentle blues.

artworks.title: Insects and Flowers
artworks.description: The image features a large dragonfly-like insect with intricate wing patterns and a cluster of tall pitcher plants with tube-like structures. The color palette includes various shades of green, blue-green, earth tones, with highlights of vibrant yellows and reds. The large insect with patterned wings is at the top center, surrounded by smaller insects on the top left and right. The pitcher plants are in the center amidst lush foliage, grass, and stones near water. Another large insect with a red and black body is at the bottom center by the water's edge.

artworks.title: Echites splendens
artworks.description: The image shows a large pinkish-white flower with a central darker pink and yellow gradient, accompanied by green leaves. The color palette includes soft pinks, whites, and shades of green. In the center is the flower, with dark green leaves surrounding it. Unopened flower buds are visible on the right. Stems intersect and blend with the leaves against a light beige background.

artworks.title: Lycaste Skinneri
artworks.description: The image displays an orchid flower with white petals and a black center, surrounded by glossy green leaves and a green stem. The color palette includes white, green, and black. The orchid flower is positioned in the upper portion of the image with petals extending outward, while the green leaves and stem are in the lower two-thirds, fanning out in various directions.

artworks.title: Amandier de la Georgie
artworks.description: The image displays a botanical illustration of an almond branch with green, elongated leaves and green almonds attached to it. The color palette includes shades of green for the leaves and almonds, brown for the stem, and a light beige background. The main branch is centered, with a cut almond to the lower left. A smaller branch with pink flowers and buds is depicted on the bottom right.

artworks.title: Amandier de la Georgie
artworks.description: The image shows a branch from an almond tree with green almond fruits and elongated green leaves. The color palette includes primarily greens for the leaves and almonds, with a beige background. One section displays a cut almond, revealing its interior, while another area shows a smaller branch with pink blossoms. The text "Amandier de la Georgie" is written near the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Amandier - Pecher
artworks.description: The image depicts a botanical illustration of a branch with multiple large green almond-like fruits, accompanied by slender, elongated green leaves. The color palette includes soft greens, with hints of pink and cream in the flower blossoms, against a beige, speckled background. The branch with the fruits and leaves is centrally located, while the cross-section of a fruit is shown towards the bottom left. A cluster of small pink flowers is visible on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Amandier pistache
artworks.description: The image shows a branch with green leaves and green almond-shaped fruits. It also includes a detailed illustration of almond flowers to the bottom left and a cut section of an almond to the bottom right. The color palette is mainly green with hints of white, pink, and yellow in the flowers against a beige background. The branch with leaves and fruits is central, with the flower cluster at the bottom left and the almond section at the bottom right.

artworks.title: Amandier a feuilles de saulle
artworks.description: The image showcases a branch with green almond fruits, elongated leaves, almond flowers in bloom and bud, and a cross-section of an almond shell showing the kernel inside. The colors are soft greens, blues, browns, and beige.

artworks.title: Amandier d'Italie
artworks.description: The image shows a branch with elongated green leaves and three large green almonds. A white almond flower with greenery is shown below the main branch, to the left. To the lower right is a cross-sectional view of an almond, displaying its green shell and nut inside. The background is a light, neutral color.

artworks.title: Laelia Euspatha
artworks.artist: Joseph Mansell after Walter Hood Fitch
artworks.description: The image displays large white flowers with pale pink centers and dark pink accents, along with long green stems and broad leaves. The color palette includes soft whites, pinks, and various shades of green. The flowers are positioned in the center, with tall green stems rising upward behind them, and large leaves extending diagonally from the upper left to lower right.

artworks.title: Laelia Anceps Stella & Barkeriana
artworks.artist: Joseph Mansell after Henry George Moon
artworks.description: The image shows several large orchid blooms with different colors and patterns. The color palette includes whites, pinks, reds, greens, and a light beige background. The white orchids are in the upper left, and the pink ones are in the middle and lower right sections. Green leaves and unopened buds are also visible, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Dendrobium (Hybridium) Venus and Dendrobium (Hybridium) Cassiope
artworks.artist: Joseph Mansell after Henry George Moon
artworks.description: The image shows a group of orchids. The largest flower has a ribboned, pinkish-red and white appearance and is placed prominently on the left side. The color palette includes soft hues such as pale greens for the stems and leaves, soft white for the petals, and deep red at the centers of the flowers. The largest orchid extends upward and slightly leftward, while smaller similar flowers are clustered towards the right, arching in different directions.

artworks.title: Dendrobium Leechianum
artworks.artist: Joseph Mansell after Henry George Moon
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of Dendrobium Leechianum orchids with large white petals and vibrant red centers, surrounded by green leaves and stems. The color palette includes pastel shades of green, white, and red against a blurred grayish background transitioning to beige at the edges. Stems hold the flowers upright, extending slightly to the left and right, and green leaves fan out from the top and sides of the stems.

artworks.title: Laelia Elegans Schilleriana
artworks.artist: Joseph Mansell after Henry George Moon
artworks.description: The image shows a group of orchids with long stems and green leaves, each topped with pink and white flowers with ruffled edges. The color palette includes soft greens, pinks, and whites. The tallest orchid is slightly to the right, with two other stems leaning diagonally to the left and forward, each with a bloom on top.

artworks.title: Cattleya Mendelii Quorndon House Var.
artworks.artist: Gustav Leutzsch after Henry George Moon
artworks.description: The image depicts three white orchid flowers with frilled edges and green leaves. The color palette includes rich greens, soft whites, and subtle hints of yellow at the flower centers. The orchids are positioned centrally in the image, with two flowers facing slightly left and one facing slightly right, while the leaves extend outwards and upwards around them.
